files.body:
package bounty

import (
	"testing"
	"time"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/urequire/v0"
)

var (
	poster = testutils.TestAddress("poster")
	hunter = testutils.TestAddress("hunter")
	other  = testutils.TestAddress("other")
	t0     = time.Unix(1_800_000_000, 0)
)

func newBoard() *Board {
	return NewBoard(Config{MinReward: 100, ReviewWindow: 48 * time.Hour})
}

func post(t *testing.T, bd *Board) *Bounty {
	b, err := bd.Post(poster, "Translate the docs", "German please", 500, 24*time.Hour, t0)
	urequire.NoError(t, err)
	return b
}

func TestPostValidation(t *testing.T) {
	bd := newBoard()

	_, err := bd.Post(poster, "  ", "", 500, 24*time.Hour, t0)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrBadTitle)

	_, err = bd.Post(poster, "ok", "", 99, 24*time.Hour, t0)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrRewardTooLow)

	_, err = bd.Post(poster, "ok", "", 500, time.Minute, t0)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrBadWindow)

	_, err = bd.Post(poster, "ok", "", 500, 365*24*time.Hour, t0)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrBadWindow)

	b := post(t, bd)
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(1), b.ID)
	uassert.True(t, b.Status == StatusOpen)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(500), bd.Escrowed())
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, bd.Stats(poster).Posted)
}

func TestHappyPath(t *testing.T) {
	bd := newBoard()
	b := post(t, bd)

	_, err := bd.Claim(b.ID, poster, t0)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrOwnBounty)

	_, err = bd.Claim(b.ID, hunter, t0.Add(time.Hour))
	urequire.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.True(t, b.Status == StatusClaimed)
	uassert.Equal(t, hunter, b.Hunter)

	_, err = bd.Claim(b.ID, other, t0.Add(time.Hour))
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrNotOpen)

	_, err = bd.Submit(b.ID, other, "https://example.com/pr/1", t0.Add(2*time.Hour))
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrNotHunter)

	_, err = bd.Submit(b.ID, hunter, "", t0.Add(2*time.Hour))
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrBadProof)

	_, err = bd.Submit(b.ID, hunter, "https://example.com/pr/1", t0.Add(2*time.Hour))
	urequire.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.True(t, b.Status == StatusSubmitted)

	_, err = bd.Approve(b.ID, other, t0.Add(3*time.Hour))
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrNotPoster)

	_, err = bd.Approve(b.ID, poster, t0.Add(3*time.Hour))
	urequire.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.True(t, b.Status == StatusPaid)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), bd.Escrowed())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(500), bd.TotalPaid())

	hs := bd.Stats(hunter)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, hs.Completed)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(500), hs.Earned)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(500), bd.Stats(poster).PaidOut)
	uassert.Equal(t, 4, len(b.History))

	_, err = bd.Approve(b.ID, poster, t0.Add(4*time.Hour))
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrNotSubmitted)
}

func TestRejectReopens(t *testing.T) {
	bd := newBoard()
	b := post(t, bd)
	bd.Claim(b.ID, hunter, t0)
	bd.Submit(b.ID, hunter, "bad work", t0)

	_, err := bd.Reject(b.ID, poster, "not German", t0.Add(time.Hour))
	urequire.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.True(t, b.Status == StatusOpen)
	uassert.Equal(t, address(""), b.Hunter)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, bd.Stats(hunter).Rejected)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, bd.Stats(poster).RejectionsMade)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(500), bd.Escrowed())

	// someone else can now take it
	_, err = bd.Claim(b.ID, other, t0.Add(2*time.Hour))
	urequire.NoError(t, err)
}

func TestClaimExpiryAndRelease(t *testing.T) {
	bd := newBoard()
	b := post(t, bd)
	bd.Claim(b.ID, hunter, t0)

	_, err := bd.Release(b.ID, other, t0.Add(23*time.Hour))
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrClaimActive)

	_, err = bd.Submit(b.ID, hunter, "late", t0.Add(25*time.Hour))
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrClaimExpired)

	_, err = bd.Release(b.ID, other, t0.Add(25*time.Hour))
	urequire.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.True(t, b.Status == StatusOpen)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, bd.Stats(hunter).Abandoned)
}

func TestUnclaim(t *testing.T) {
	bd := newBoard()
	b := post(t, bd)
	bd.Claim(b.ID, hunter, t0)

	_, err := bd.Unclaim(b.ID, other, t0)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrNotHunter)

	_, err = bd.Unclaim(b.ID, hunter, t0)
	urequire.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.True(t, b.Status == StatusOpen)
}

func TestCollectAfterReviewWindow(t *testing.T) {
	bd := newBoard()
	b := post(t, bd)
	bd.Claim(b.ID, hunter, t0)
	bd.Submit(b.ID, hunter, "done", t0.Add(time.Hour))

	_, err := bd.Collect(b.ID, hunter, t0.Add(48*time.Hour))
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrReviewActive)

	_, err = bd.Collect(b.ID, other, t0.Add(50*time.Hour))
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrNotHunter)

	_, err = bd.Collect(b.ID, hunter, t0.Add(50*time.Hour))
	urequire.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.True(t, b.Status == StatusPaid)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(500), bd.Stats(hunter).Earned)
}

func TestCancel(t *testing.T) {
	bd := newBoard()
	b := post(t, bd)

	_, err := bd.Cancel(b.ID, other, t0)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrNotPoster)

	bd.Claim(b.ID, hunter, t0)
	_, err = bd.Cancel(b.ID, poster, t0)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrNotOpen)

	bd.Unclaim(b.ID, hunter, t0)
	_, err = bd.Cancel(b.ID, poster, t0)
	urequire.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.True(t, b.Status == StatusCancelled)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), bd.Escrowed())
}

func TestListAndLeaderboard(t *testing.T) {
	bd := newBoard()
	for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
		post(t, bd)
	}
	// hunter completes #1 and #2, other completes #3
	for _, id := range []uint64{1, 2} {
		bd.Claim(id, hunter, t0)
		bd.Submit(id, hunter, "ok", t0)
		bd.Approve(id, poster, t0)
	}
	bd.Claim(3, other, t0)
	bd.Submit(3, other, "ok", t0)
	bd.Approve(3, poster, t0)

	open, total := bd.List(ByStatus(StatusOpen), 0, 10)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, total)
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(5), open[0].ID) // newest first

	page, total := bd.List(nil, 1, 2)
	uassert.Equal(t, 5, total)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, len(page))
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(4), page[0].ID)

	uassert.Equal(t, 3, bd.Count(ByStatus(StatusPaid)))
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, bd.Count(ByAddress(hunter)))

	top := bd.Leaderboard(10)
	urequire.Equal(t, 2, len(top))
	uassert.Equal(t, hunter, top[0].Address)
	uassert.Equal(t, other, top[1].Address)

	uassert.Equal(t, 1, len(bd.Leaderboard(1)))
	uassert.Equal(t, 3, bd.Participants())
}

func TestStatusRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	for _, s := range []Status{StatusOpen, StatusClaimed, StatusSubmitted, StatusPaid, StatusCancelled} {
		got, ok := ParseStatus(s.String())
		uassert.True(t, ok)
		uassert.True(t, got == s)
	}
	_, ok := ParseStatus("nope")
	uassert.False(t, ok)
}

files.body:
package barkeep

import (
	"chain"
	"chain/banker"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"gno.land/p/g1vx95s9pfwpg2flkw6x8z35546espgqemks8zkm/bounty/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/urequire/v0"
)

var (
	alice    = testutils.TestAddress("alice") // poster
	bob      = testutils.TestAddress("bob")   // hunter
	carol    = testutils.TestAddress("carol") // bystander
	realmAdr = chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/g1vx95s9pfwpg2flkw6x8z35546espgqemks8zkm/barkeep")
)

func reset() {
	board = bounty.NewBoard(board.Config())
}

func ugnot(n int64) chain.Coins { return chain.Coins{{"ugnot", n}} }

func balance(addr address) int64 {
	return banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoins(addr).AmountOf("ugnot")
}

// postAs simulates a wallet call to Post with coins attached: the chain
// moves the coins to the realm before the call, so the test issues them.
func postAs(cur realm, addr address, reward int64, title string) uint64 {
	testing.IssueCoins(realmAdr, ugnot(reward))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(addr))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(reward))
	return Post(cross(cur), title, "Some details", 24)
}

func TestPostAndPay(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	id := postAs(cur, alice, 5_000_000, "Translate the README")
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(1), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(5_000_000), Escrowed())

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Claim(cross(cur), id)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/example/pr/1")

	// only the poster may approve
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "only the poster", func() { Approve(cross(cur), id) })

	before := balance(bob)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Approve(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, before+5_000_000, balance(bob))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), Escrowed())

	_, _, _, status, hunter := GetBounty(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, "paid", status)
	uassert.Equal(t, bob, hunter)

	completed, earned, score := Reputation(bob)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, completed)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(5_000_000), earned)
	uassert.Equal(t, 10, score)
}

func TestPostValidation(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	// no coins attached
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "attach the reward", func() { Post(cross(cur), "x", "", 24) })

	// wrong denom
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ufoo", 5_000_000}})
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "only ugnot", func() { Post(cross(cur), "x", "", 24) })

	// below minimum
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(10))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "below the board minimum", func() { Post(cross(cur), "x", "", 24) })

	// bad claim window
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(5_000_000))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "claim window", func() { Post(cross(cur), "x", "", 0) })

	// coins sent to a non-payable function
	id := postAs(cur, alice, 2_000_000, "ok")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(1))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "does not take coins", func() { Claim(cross(cur), id) })
}

func TestCancelRefunds(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	id := postAs(cur, alice, 3_000_000, "Draw a gnome")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "only the poster", func() { Cancel(cross(cur), id) })

	before := balance(alice)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Cancel(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, before+3_000_000, balance(alice))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), Escrowed())
}

func TestRejectAndReclaim(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	id := postAs(cur, alice, 2_000_000, "Write a test")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Claim(cross(cur), id)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "not really")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Reject(cross(cur), id, "please add tests")
	_, _, _, status, _ := GetBounty(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, "open", status)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Claim(cross(cur), id)
	_, _, _, status, hunter := GetBounty(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, "claimed", status)
	uassert.Equal(t, carol, hunter)
}

func TestCollectWhenPosterGhosts(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	id := postAs(cur, alice, 4_000_000, "Fix a bug")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Claim(cross(cur), id)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/fix")

	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "review window", func() { Collect(cross(cur), id) })

	skip(73 * time.Hour)
	before := balance(bob)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Collect(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, before+4_000_000, balance(bob))
}

func TestReleaseExpiredClaim(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	id := postAs(cur, alice, 1_000_000, "Quick task")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Claim(cross(cur), id)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "not expired", func() { Release(cross(cur), id) })

	skip(25 * time.Hour)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Release(cross(cur), id)
	_, _, _, status, _ := GetBounty(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, "open", status)
}

func TestRender(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	id := postAs(cur, alice, 1_500_000, "Brew *strong* coffee [x](javascript:alert(1))")

	home := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "Barkeep"), "header")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "1.5 GNOT"), "reward formatting")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "Pin a new bounty"), "post button")
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(home, "](javascript"), "title must be sanitized")

	detail := Render("bounty/1")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "Claim this bounty"), "claim action")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "func=Claim"), "tx link")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Claim(cross(cur), id)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/coffee")
	detail = Render("bounty/1")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "Approve & pay"), "approve action")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "(https://example.com/coffee)"), "proof link")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Approve(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("hunters"), "🥇"), "leaderboard")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("u/"+bob.String()), "Completed | 1"), "profile")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("status/paid"), "#1"), "filter")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("bounty/99"), "No bounty"), "missing")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("help"), "How the tavern works"), "help")

	urequire.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("nope/nope/nope"), "Nothing pinned"), "404")
}

func TestGnotFormat(t *testing.T) {
	uassert.Equal(t, "1 GNOT", gnot(1_000_000))
	uassert.Equal(t, "1.5 GNOT", gnot(1_500_000))
	uassert.Equal(t, "0.000001 GNOT", gnot(1))
	uassert.Equal(t, "12.34 GNOT", gnot(12_340_000))
}

// skip advances the block clock. SkipHeights resets the realm context,
// so callers must set the caller again afterwards.
func skip(d time.Duration) {
	testing.SkipHeights(int64(d/(5*time.Second)) + 1)
}
